heroes.name: Mara Venn
heroes.signature: Guards allies, then punishes pressure at the front.
heroes.strength: Reliable protection and front-line control.
heroes.weakness: Most defining actions fail from the back ranks.
heroes.summary: Durable frontliner who guards allies and controls enemy ranks.

heroes.name: Ivo Senn
heroes.signature: Turns marks and formation changes into energy and protection.
heroes.strength: Excellent hand, energy, and rank correction.
heroes.weakness: Loses its strongest tools when forced to rank 1.
heroes.summary: Flexible controller who moves combatants and manipulates energy.

heroes.name: Dr. Orra Vale
heroes.signature: Repairs health, stress, wounds, and Death's Door crises.
heroes.strength: Best direct recovery and emergency stabilization.
heroes.weakness: Low damage makes slow fights increasingly dangerous.
heroes.summary: Dedicated recovery specialist for health, stress, and emergencies.

heroes.name: Kei Rook
heroes.signature: Marks any target, cycles the hand, and fires from the back.
heroes.strength: Wide target reach and high marked-target burst.
heroes.weakness: Forward displacement disables its best shots.
heroes.summary: Mobile backliner who marks targets and cycles through the deck.

heroes.name: Dax Rell
heroes.signature: Crashes into point-blank range and scatters the enemy line.
heroes.strength: Immediate front-rank damage and displacement.
heroes.weakness: Recoil and self-stress demand formation support.
heroes.summary: Explosive front-rank attacker with burst damage and forced movement.

heroes.name: Nia Voss
heroes.signature: Reorders and disables enemies while gambling with stress.
heroes.strength: Powerful whole-line control and setup.
heroes.weakness: Fragile, stress-hungry, and weak when pulled forward.
heroes.summary: Fragile control specialist who trades stress for stuns and disruption.

heroes.name: Bram Coil
heroes.signature: Smooths the shared hand and distributes scarce protection.
heroes.strength: Makes expensive and mixed-owner decks more consistent.
heroes.weakness: Adds little burst pressure without allied finishers.
heroes.summary: Card-economy support who distributes protection and extra actions.

heroes.name: Sable Kade
heroes.signature: Creates or cashes marks, then vanishes before retaliation.
heroes.strength: Precise payoff damage against priority targets.
heroes.weakness: Needs setup and safe back ranks for peak output.
heroes.summary: Precise mobile assassin who exploits marks and vulnerable targets.

heroes.name: Dr. Yara Moss
heroes.signature: Cultivates wounds, then converts them into damage or recovery.
heroes.strength: Sustained attrition and adaptable treatment.
heroes.weakness: Slow setup can lose races against immediate pressure.
heroes.summary: Attrition specialist using wounds, weakness, and regenerative support.

heroes.name: Unit Lumen
heroes.signature: Anchors the line while charging flexible hardlight actions.
heroes.strength: Reliable defense, guard, and energy support.
heroes.weakness: Card draw can outpace the party's shared energy.
heroes.summary: Resilient energy support with hardlight defenses and reliable control.

heroes.name: Tal Ren
heroes.signature: Evades a committed attack and answers it with a riposte.
heroes.strength: Efficient single-target counterpressure.
heroes.weakness: Wide attacks and enemy backliners bypass its duel.
heroes.summary: Mobile counterattacker who evades single hits and punishes direct attackers.

heroes.name: Mox Calder
heroes.signature: Turns setup and stress into formation-wide bombardment.
heroes.strength: Exceptional reach and multi-target pressure.
heroes.weakness: Fragile and nearly inert when dragged to the front.
heroes.summary: Fragile backliner who trades stress and setup for heavy bursts and volleys.

heroes.name: Sister Ilex
heroes.signature: Absorbs dread while cleansing and focusing the whole crew.
heroes.strength: Broad morale and status stabilization.
heroes.weakness: Protective turns rely on allies to finish threats.
heroes.summary: Morale support who cleanses ailments, inspires allies, and accepts stress for them.

heroes.name: Pax Null
heroes.signature: Edits enemy states while filtering the shared hand.
heroes.strength: Strong debuffs, setup, and card-flow control.
heroes.weakness: Low durability and poor function from rank 1.
heroes.summary: Disruption specialist who marks, weakens, and jams hostile action loops.

heroes.name: Oren Pike
heroes.signature: Steers specialists into position and hostile ranks out of it.
heroes.strength: Cheap formation correction and displacement.
heroes.weakness: Movement without the right partners wastes tempo.
heroes.summary: Formation support who steers allies and enemies while granting evasive cover.

heroes.name: Eira Glace
heroes.signature: Freezes exposed targets while preserving endangered allies.
heroes.strength: Combines control with resilient rescue tools.
heroes.weakness: Area attacks are costly and immediate damage is modest.
heroes.summary: Cryogenic defender who slows pressure with blocks, weakness, and emergency preservation.

heroes.name: Sol Briar
heroes.signature: Grows wounds into a network of thorns and recovery.
heroes.strength: Sustained protection and attrition support.
heroes.weakness: Needs time or wound setup before it becomes efficient.
heroes.summary: Hydroponic support who grows protection while rooting and wearing down hostiles.

heroes.name: Hark Vela
heroes.signature: Tempers stress into armor and devastating close strikes.
heroes.strength: High durability and front-rank pressure.
heroes.weakness: Heat-driven stress becomes dangerous without relief.
heroes.summary: Foundry bruiser who converts heat and stress into armor and close-range force.

heroes.name: Saint Cira
heroes.signature: Escalates critical energy while containing its stress fallout.
heroes.strength: Flexible energy, marks, wounds, and party defense.
heroes.weakness: Repeated rites can trigger an affliction spiral.
heroes.summary: Volatile reactor mystic balancing party protection against radiation-scarred aggression.

heroes.name: Miko Spore
heroes.signature: Links wounded enemies and allies through restorative spores.
heroes.strength: Efficient attrition support and group cleansing.
heroes.weakness: Limited burst and vulnerable to forward displacement.
heroes.summary: Fungal medic spreading restorative networks and debilitating spores across formations.

heroes.name: Neris Drown
heroes.signature: Uses pressure and lifelines to drag both formations forward.
heroes.strength: Strong line manipulation and stress protection.
heroes.weakness: Cannot pressure enemy back ranks without setup.
heroes.summary: Flooded-zone controller using pressure, ballast, and harpoons to rearrange combat.

heroes.name: Vey Ion
heroes.signature: Chains marked targets into energy and reactive lightning.
heroes.strength: Fast setup, wide reach, and explosive tempo.
heroes.weakness: Fragile and dependent on protected back ranks.
heroes.summary: Storm-channeling striker with chain attacks, reactive guards, and formation disruption.

heroes.name: Ada Quill
heroes.signature: Catalogs targets while revising draws and discards.
heroes.strength: Precise setup and shared-hand filtering.
heroes.weakness: Very poor access to defining cards from the front.
heroes.summary: Archive tactician who marks priority records and restores allies from impossible ledgers.

heroes.name: Oss Null
heroes.signature: Trades stress and position to expose impossible openings.
heroes.strength: Exceptional formation control and emergency evasion.
heroes.weakness: Risk costs compound quickly without stabilization.
heroes.summary: Risk-heavy void adept who bends enemy ranks and exposes targets through absence.

heroes.name: Tern Ivory
heroes.signature: Builds protection from wounds and near-death emergencies.
heroes.strength: Durable guarding and Death's Door stabilization.
heroes.weakness: Short attack reach and modest tempo when nobody is hurt.
heroes.summary: Ossuary guardian who builds durable scaffolds and splints from battlefield remains.

squads.name: Bulkhead Basics
squads.playstyle: Defend, mark a priority target, and convert that setup into efficient damage.
squads.strength: Clear roles, dependable recovery, and answers from every rank.
squads.weakness: Modest area damage makes crowded fights slower.
squads.signature: Scout marks targets for the Engineer while the Warden protects the Medic.

squads.name: Breach Protocol
squads.playstyle: Break enemy order, build marks, and spend the resulting tempo on aggressive turns.
squads.strength: Strong card flow, formation control, and front-rank burst.
squads.weakness: Limited direct healing makes damage stick between fights.
squads.signature: Hacker marks openings; Breacher and Synth exploit them.

squads.name: Wound Ward
squads.playstyle: Spread wounds across both formations, then turn them into healing, block, and finishers.
squads.strength: Excellent attrition, rescue tools, and enemy-rank control.
squads.weakness: Setup-heavy opening turns can fall behind immediate pressure.
squads.signature: Biologist grows wounds that power Mycologist and Bonewright.

squads.name: Static Choir
squads.playstyle: Reposition constantly, evade retaliation, and convert stress into precise bombardment.
squads.strength: Flexible movement, morale control, and strong reach.
squads.weakness: Bad movement strands the Artillerist or wastes counters.
squads.signature: Pilot fixes ranks; Chaplain absorbs the Artillerist's stress.

squads.name: Unstable Research
squads.playstyle: Accept stress and positional risk to chain control, energy, and vulnerable payoffs.
squads.strength: Powerful control and explosive conditional turns.
squads.weakness: Stress compounds; poor sequencing can break formation.
squads.signature: Cryonaut control buys time for reactor and void payoffs.

squads.name: Marked Vector
squads.playstyle: Establish a marked target, cash it from two ranks, then rotate the back line.
squads.strength: Dense mark production and precise payoff reach.
squads.weakness: Unmarked crowds blunt the squad's best damage.
squads.signature: Scout and Operative expose a target for Engineer feedback.

squads.name: Scar Garden
squads.playstyle: Seed wounds, shelter the slow setup, then harvest attrition as block and healing.
squads.strength: Deep wound production with several salvage conversions.
squads.weakness: Immediate burst races arrive before the garden matures.
squads.signature: Biologist and Horticulturist feed Mycologist's wound network.

squads.name: Countercurrent
squads.playstyle: Dance through ranks while riposte and artillery punish the openings.
squads.strength: Exceptional formation repair and back-rank reach.
squads.weakness: An unnecessary move can disable the next owner's card.
squads.signature: Pilot routes Duelist counters around a protected cannon.

squads.name: Signal Lock
squads.playstyle: Displace and disable threats while a guarded backline builds a storm payoff.
squads.strength: Layered control, guard, and wide-rank answers.
squads.weakness: Lower direct damage makes cleansers and healers urgent.
squads.signature: Diver pulls targets into Cryonaut and Stormcaller control.

squads.name: Discard Cell
squads.playstyle: Cycle the shared hand aggressively and turn discarded options into tempo.
squads.strength: High draw velocity finds positional answers quickly.
squads.weakness: Over-cycling burns setup cards before their payoffs arrive.
squads.signature: Quartermaster and Archivist filter cards for Breacher bursts.

squads.name: Last Lantern
squads.playstyle: Stabilize Death's Door, protect a fragile rear, and remain functional after loss.
squads.strength: Many crisis answers and strong casualty recovery.
squads.weakness: Healthy turns are slower and offer modest pressure.
squads.signature: Bonewright buys time for Medic and Chaplain rescue lines.

squads.name: Reactor Broadside
squads.playstyle: Mark the line, absorb recoil, and fire costly attacks across every hostile rank.
squads.strength: Spectacular area pressure with mark and energy bridges.
squads.weakness: Rank disruption and stress can silence both rear strikers.
squads.signature: Reactor energy drives Stormcaller arcs and Artillerist volleys.

squads.name: After Action
squads.playstyle: Push early tempo, then convert a casualty or crisis into a controlled recovery.
squads.strength: Balanced burst, hand control, healing, and post-loss play.
squads.weakness: The doctrine taxes the first turns while everyone survives.
squads.signature: Quartermaster keeps Medic rescue and Operative payoff cards moving.

Thawed service channels offer fast crossings through costly ice.

Quench rails remain cooler and faster than exposed slag floors.

afflictions.name: Aggressive
afflictions.description: Deal more damage but gain less block.

afflictions.name: Withdrawn
afflictions.description: Healing and stress relief are weaker.

afflictions.name: Reckless
afflictions.description: Cards cost less, but stress rises quickly.

afflictions.name: Obsessive
afflictions.description: Block is stronger, but cards cost more.

mutations.name: Barricaded
mutations.description: The front hostile opens behind visible block.

mutations.name: Screen Link
mutations.description: The front hostile guards the rearmost ally for two enemy phases.

mutations.name: Prey Protocol
mutations.description: The weakest crew member begins marked, inviting coordinated payoff.

mutations.name: Phase Skitter
mutations.description: The rearmost hostile opens with one consumed dodge.

mutations.name: Countermesh
mutations.description: The front hostile opens with a finite riposte window.

mutations.name: Overclock
mutations.description: The first striker opens focused for one enemy phase.

mutations.name: Rank Breaker
mutations.description: The opening hostile action pulls the front crew member one rank back.

mutations.name: Triage Node
mutations.description: After each enemy phase, the weakest hostile receives finite repair.

mutations.name: Third Bell
mutations.description: The third crew card each round grants the front hostile block.

mutations.name: Death Surge
mutations.description: The nearest surviving hostile gains focus when an ally dies.

mutations.name: Reinforcement Call
mutations.description: The first vacant hostile rank may receive one disclosed reserve.

mutations.name: Clean Room
mutations.description: At enemy-phase end, the weakest hostile sheds one negative status.

mutations.name: Rime Shell
mutations.description: Cryogenic hostiles shorten the first stun applied each combat.

mutations.name: Spore Link
mutations.description: When an ally dies, a living hostile wounds the front crew member.

mutations.name: Undertow
mutations.description: At enemy-phase end, the front crew member is pulled back one rank.

mutations.name: Slag Vent
mutations.description: At enemy-phase end, one wound reaches every unblocked crew member.

events.name: Sealed Locker
events.text: A crew locker is fused into a buckled junction. Its breaker could open either steel or road.

choices.label: Cut it open (1 supply)
choices.summary: Spend 1 supply for a card reward; every survivor gains 3 stress.

choices.label: Brace the junction
choices.summary: Stabilise 4 nearby terrain tiles and end local patrol alert.

events.name: Black Box
events.text: The recorder repeats the final seven seconds and indexes static shapes behind the voice.

choices.label: Listen and map the end
choices.summary: Gain a card choice and reveal regional static sites; every survivor gains 8 stress.

choices.label: Erase its gaze
choices.summary: Suppress the nearest hazard field and relieve 3 stress from every survivor.

events.name: Coolant Leak
events.text: A freezing plume crosses a useful route and feeds the nearest pressure field.

choices.label: Patch it (1 supply)
choices.summary: Spend 1 supply to suppress the nearest hazard field and recover 10 light.

choices.label: Push through
choices.summary: Every survivor becomes weak; stabilise 3 nearby terrain tiles.

events.name: Sleeping Pods
events.text: Four pods remain powered. One display counts backward; nearby patrols wait for the final digit.

choices.label: Drain their cells
choices.summary: Recover 22 light and alert local patrols for 10 ticks.

choices.label: Leave them sleeping
choices.summary: End local patrol alert and relieve 3 stress from every survivor.

events.name: Quartermaster
events.text: The quartermaster still grips a field case beside a route scored by passing bodies.

choices.label: Take the case
choices.summary: Gain 2 supplies and alert local patrols for 8 ticks.

choices.label: Record their name
choices.summary: End local patrol alert and relieve 6 stress from every survivor.

events.name: Maintenance Voice
events.text: A cheerful voice requests authorization to expose every indexed fault on this deck.

choices.label: Authorize survey (1 supply)
choices.summary: Spend 1 supply to reveal regional static sites and receive a card choice.

choices.label: Order emergency grounding
choices.summary: Suppress the nearest hazard field but alert local patrols for 8 ticks.

events.name: Fresh Trail
events.text: A bright trail disappears into living growth while the local patrol circuit turns toward it.

choices.label: Follow before it closes
choices.summary: Gain one item and alert local patrols for 10 ticks.

choices.label: Seal and sterilise it
choices.summary: Lose 5 light and suppress the nearest hazard field.

events.name: Observation Glass
events.text: The stars bend around an absence, briefly outlining every fixed danger in the region.

choices.label: Keep watching
choices.summary: Reveal regional static sites and gain a card choice; every survivor gains 10 stress.

choices.label: Ground the shutter
choices.summary: Lose 8 light and suppress the nearest hazard field.

events.name: Unsent Message
events.text: A terminal holds a final message and a partial maintenance route addressed to no one aboard.

choices.label: Read it aloud
choices.summary: Heal every survivor for 4 and relieve 4 stress from each.

choices.label: Salvage its route map
choices.summary: Gain 1 supply and stabilise 4 nearby terrain tiles.

events.name: Unstable Cell
events.text: A cracked power cell can feed the lamps or safely discharge into local machinery.

choices.label: Install it
choices.summary: Recover 30 light; every survivor becomes marked.

choices.label: Discharge into the route
choices.summary: Suppress the nearest hazard field and end local patrol alert.
